PasarCCTV Platform
nodes.summary: Integrated B2B Marketplace platform with microservice-ready architecture.

nodes.label: FastAPI Backend
nodes.summary: Core asynchronous backend service built on FastAPI/Python handling transactions and marketplace APIs.

nodes.label: Frontend Web Application
nodes.summary: Public web app built with Nuxt 4, Vue 3, Pinia, and Tailwind CSS v4.

nodes.label: Admin Dashboard
nodes.summary: Operational management dashboard built with Vue and Vite.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL Database
nodes.summary: Primary relational database accessed asynchronously via SQLAlchemy 2.0 and asyncpg.

nodes.label: DragonflyDB
nodes.summary: Redis-compatible high-performance cache and message broker for fast response times (<50ms).

nodes.label: Elasticsearch
nodes.summary: Full-text search engine backing catalog and product stock queries.

nodes.label: Celery Task Queue
nodes.summary: Background worker task queue for asynchronous processing.

nodes.label: Alembic Migrations
nodes.summary: Database schema migration tool synchronizing SQLAlchemy ORM models.

nodes.label: User & Auth Domain
nodes.summary: Handles authentication, credentials, session management, address books, cart, and wishlist (/auth/user, /cart, /wishlist).

nodes.label: Catalog & Stock Domain
nodes.summary: Manages categories, stock/products, variants, media assets, brands, and addons (/stok, /category, /brands, /addon).

nodes.label: Transaction & Shipping Domain
nodes.summary: Handles checkout lifecycle, stock reservation, transaction items, recap, and shipping route calculations (/transaksi, /cek/shipping, /recap).

nodes.label: Service Bookings Domain
nodes.summary: Manages non-physical services like CCTV installation, maintenance schedules, technician assignments, and time-collision handling (/jasa, /booking).

nodes.label: Promo & CMS Domain
nodes.summary: Handles coupon validation, quota rate limiting, flash sales, usage logs, banners, and CMS assets (/promos, /banner, /image-sections, /about).

nodes.label: Settings & Admin Operations Domain
nodes.summary: Handles system settings, global tax configuration, admin coupons, and staff activity audit logs (/settings, /admin/coupon, /activity).

nodes.label: CORS Middleware
nodes.summary: Proxy-level security layer restricting cross-origin requests to trusted origins like localhost and Vercel domains.

nodes.label: Customer
nodes.summary: Marketplace customer who browses catalog, purchases CCTV products, and books installation services.

nodes.label: Technician
nodes.summary: Field technician who receives service job assignments and updates booking execution status via mobile.

nodes.label: Admin / Owner
nodes.summary: Store owner or administrator managing catalog inventory, bookings, and operations via dashboard.

nodes.label: PasarCCTV System
nodes.summary: Modern marketplace system for CCTV sales, physical shipments, and professional installation services.

nodes.label: Payment Gateway
nodes.summary: External payment processor (Midtrans / Xendit) handling transactions and emitting webhook payment callbacks.

nodes.label: Logistic API
nodes.summary: External logistics service (RajaOngkir) calculating shipping rates, couriers, and tracking shipments.

nodes.label: WhatsApp API
nodes.summary: External messaging provider (Fonnte / Watzap) sending automated transactional notifications.

nodes.label: Frontend System Boundary
nodes.summary: C4 container boundary encapsulating the user-facing web and mobile interface.

nodes.label: Backend System Boundary
nodes.summary: C4 container boundary containing the core REST API service and asynchronous task workers.

nodes.label: Data & Search Layer Boundary
nodes.summary: C4 container boundary hosting persistent storage, caching layer, and full-text search engine.

nodes.label: Web App (PWA)
nodes.summary: Progressive Web App built with Nuxt 4, Vue 3, and Tailwind CSS offering mobile-first responsive marketplace UI.

nodes.label: FastAPI Service
nodes.summary: Core asynchronous REST API backend service written in Python with modular routers and asyncpg.

nodes.label: Celery Workers
nodes.summary: Python Celery worker processes executing asynchronous background jobs, search indexing, and notification dispatches.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.summary: Primary relational database managing persistent transactional data, ACID constraints, and stock inventory.

nodes.label: DragonflyDB
nodes.summary: High-performance in-memory Redis-compatible datastore used for caching, slot locking, and Celery broker queues.

nodes.label: Elasticsearch
nodes.summary: Dedicated search engine powering catalog search with fuzzy matching, typo tolerance, and relevance scoring.

nodes.label: Supabase Realtime
nodes.summary: Realtime event pushing layer delivering instant updates to clients without server polling.

nodes.label: Cloudflare Tunnels
nodes.summary: Secure reverse tunnel exposing web traffic safely without exposing public inbound network ports.

nodes.label: Docker Compose
nodes.summary: Containerization runtime defining and running multi-container PasarCCTV services.

nodes.label: USER
nodes.summary: User account entity storing UUID, email, password hash, and authorization role.

nodes.label: USER_ADDRESS
nodes.summary: Customer physical addresses used for calculating shipping rates and delivery destinations.

nodes.label: CATEGORY
nodes.summary: Top-level product catalog classification entity.

nodes.label: SUBCATEGORY
nodes.summary: Specific subcategory dividing product categories and classifying stock items.

nodes.label: STOCK
nodes.summary: Product stock inventory entity tracking SKU, name, quantity, price, and subcategory.

nodes.label: ASSET
nodes.summary: Media assets and imagery linked to product stock items.

nodes.label: TRANSACTION
nodes.summary: Physical product transaction entity tracking buyer, order status, and grand total.

nodes.label: TRANSACTION_ITEM
nodes.summary: Line item inside a purchase transaction referencing the stock item, quantity, and unit price.

nodes.label: SHIPMENT
nodes.summary: Logistics delivery shipment record containing courier service and tracking details.

nodes.label: SERVICE_PACKAGE
nodes.summary: CCTV installation or maintenance service package offerings.

nodes.label: SERVICE_PACKAGE_ITEM
nodes.summary: Itemized scope and components included within a service package.

nodes.label: SERVICE_BOOKING
nodes.summary: Service booking appointment linking user, package, assigned technician, and scheduled timestamp.

nodes.label: SERVICE_PAYMENT
nodes.summary: Payment transaction record associated with a booked service appointment.

nodes.label: SERVICE_TECHNICIAN
nodes.summary: Technician assignment profile for fulfilling on-site service appointments.

nodes.label: PROMO
nodes.summary: Promotional coupon entity defining code, discount type, and discount value.

nodes.label: PROMO_ITEM
nodes.summary: Specific stock products eligible for a promotional discount campaign.

nodes.label: PROMO_USAGE
nodes.summary: Log tracking individual user redemptions of promotional coupons.

nodes.label: PROMO_TRANSACTION
nodes.summary: Association between applied promo vouchers and physical checkout transactions.

nodes.label: Nuxt 4 Frontend
nodes.summary: Public web application built with Nuxt 4, Vue 3 Composition API, Tailwind CSS v4, and Nuxt UI for retail customers and B2B clients.

nodes.label: Admin SPA Dashboard
nodes.summary: Internal single-page application dashboard built with Vite, Vue 3, Vue Router, and Supabase Auth RBAC for store operations and management.

nodes.label: Pinia State Management
nodes.summary: Reactive central state management layer in app/stores/ orchestrating money-math, cart logic, coupons, and realtime notifications.

nodes.label: useCheckoutStore
nodes.summary: Pinia store handling cart items, equipment addons, weight accumulation for couriers, subtotal, discountPromo, and reactive grandTotal calculation.

nodes.label: usePromoStore
nodes.summary: Pinia store handling coupon validation, promo discounts/cashback, pre-populating item_uuid requirements, and calling /promos/validate.

nodes.label: useNotificationStore
nodes.summary: Pinia store consuming Supabase Realtime streams to trigger UI alerts, toasts, and snackbars for events like payment success or technician arrival.

nodes.label: PasarCCTV Design System
nodes.summary: Visual system featuring Dark Forest Green theme, gold accents, glassmorphism backdrop-blur, Tailwind CSS v4, and mobile touch-friendly ergonomics.

nodes.label: Top Search Bar Component
nodes.summary: Aggressive sticky top search bar component critical for B2B technical part discovery.

nodes.label: Product Cards Component
nodes.summary: Spacious product display cards adhering to generous padding, margins, and clear visual hierarchy.

nodes.label: Service CTA Banner Component
nodes.summary: Wide horizontal Call-to-Action banner visually isolating technician service bookings from physical product catalog.

nodes.label: Rounded Category Icons Component
nodes.summary: Touch-friendly rounded category navigation buttons optimized for mobile and tablet interactions.

nodes.label: Admin Views (src/views/)
nodes.summary: Full-screen views in Admin SPA representing Dashboard, Order Management Tables, and Catalog Addition forms.

nodes.label: Admin UI Components (src/components/)
nodes.summary: Reusable admin interface components including reactive data tables and standard input form elements.

nodes.label: Admin Services (src/services/)
nodes.summary: Axios-based API client wrappers dedicated to invoking administrator endpoints on the FastAPI backend.

nodes.label: Supabase Realtime Client
nodes.summary: WebSocket and realtime streaming integration powering live notifications and updates in frontend stores.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth RBAC
nodes.summary: Role-Based Access Control enforcing JWT token verification for internal staff, field supervisors, and business owners.

nodes.label: API /promos/validate
nodes.summary: Nitro / FastAPI backend validation route called by usePromoStore to calculate coupon eligibility and discount amounts.

nodes.label: Leaflet Location Mapping
nodes.summary: Interactive mapping library integration used on the frontend for geographic location picking and technician service areas.

nodes.label: GSAP & VueUse Motion
nodes.summary: Animation libraries powering UI interactions, transitions, and micro-animations across frontend components.
